maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: this recurring KV eviction pattern keeps reappearing. We need a razor‑thin playbook (3 checks), exact safe commands, clear owners, and deadlines so oncall has a single page to follow.

kevin: I can own the runbook PR. I'll make it one page: Verify -> Contain -> Failover, with explicit PromQL and CLI snippets.

sam: I'll provide the diagnostic note about prefix-skew and attach a small load harness.

lisa: Product wants the rollback wording and an opt-in flag for Dedicated customers; include customer-notify template.

akshay: oncall: please include an "approved mitigation" action tied to RBAC so we can click from pager and avoid paste errors.

maria: Draft triage (proposal): 1) Verify: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 50` OR `model_kv_miss_rate > 0.2` 2) Contain: `redwoodctl models patch <model> --set cache.read_only=true` + emergency scale if autoscale fails 3) Failover: shift traffic to quantized fallback if p95 > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes.

kevin: Commands to include: `redwoodctl models patch model-foo --set cache.read_only=true`, `redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-foo-pool --add-replicas 2`, `redwoodctl traffic shift --from model-foo --to model-foo-quantized --percent 100`. Will open PR and add TL;DR.

runbook-bot: Created action RB-1759 assigned to kevin, due 1760073600.

maria: Owner/timeline: kevin -> PR by Fri EOD (1760073600), sam -> attach tests by Tue (1760246400), maria -> staging smoke + merge by Thu (1760429200). akshay will file infra ticket for mitigation button and RBAC.

lisa: I'll add the product-notify snippet and rollback wording into the PR.

kevin: Will ping reviewers on Friday morning. Short meeting to verify merged runbook: Mon 10am PT.

maria: Please update the postmortem action tracker when tasks are complete. Escalate here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
